title: Planning Commission - Regular Meeting
overview: Based on the published agenda, the Planning Commission held a regular meeting scheduled to consider four substantive items including historic property preservation, a laundromat conditional use permit, and two wireless communications facility renewals. The meeting was set to address land use decisions that would be final unless appealed within ten days.

agenda.item: Historic Resources Commission Application No. 2026-11 and Historic Register Categorization No. 2026-6 for 1101 West Riviera Drive
Conditional Use Permit No. 2026-0017 for Laundromat at 413 West Seventeenth Street, Unit 102
Conditional Use Permit No. 2026-0014 for Wireless Communications Facility at 2624 South Hickory Street
Conditional Use Permit No. 2026-0016 for Wireless Communications Facility at 1200 East Glenwood Place

discussions.item: Historic Resources Commission Application No. 2026-11 and Historic Register Categorization No. 2026-6 for 1101 West Riviera Drive
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to consider approval of a Historic Resources Commission Application and Historic Register Categorization to place the single-family residence property at 1101 West Riviera Drive on the Santa Ana Register of Historical Properties as a 'Contributive' property. The applicants, Esmeralda and Anthony Henry Terusa, were also seeking approval of a Historic Property Preservation Agreement with the City, with recommended action to adopt a resolution and recommend City Council authorization of a Mills Act agreement.

discussions.item: Conditional Use Permit No. 2026-0017 for Laundromat at 413 West Seventeenth Street, Unit 102
discussions.body: The Commission was set to consider a conditional use permit request to reestablish a laundromat within an existing 2,051-square-foot commercial tenant space in a multi-tenant commercial building located in the Community Commercial zoning district. The project was expected to be reviewed for compliance with municipal code requirements, with recommended action to adopt a resolution approving the permit as conditioned.

discussions.item: Conditional Use Permit No. 2026-0014 for Wireless Communications Facility at 2624 South Hickory Street
discussions.body: The Commission was scheduled to consider approval of a conditional use permit to renew entitlements for an existing 57-foot tall major wireless communications facility designed as a 'mono-pine' located in the Light Industrial zoning district. The renewal application was expected to be evaluated under CEQA exemption guidelines with recommended action to adopt a resolution approving the permit as conditioned.

discussions.item: Conditional Use Permit No. 2026-0016 for Wireless Communications Facility at 1200 East Glenwood Place
discussions.body: The Commission was set to consider a conditional use permit to renew entitlements for an existing 60-foot tall major wireless communications facility designed as a mono-eucalyptus in the Light Industrial zoning district. The renewal was expected to be reviewed with recommended action to adopt a resolution approving the permit as conditioned under CEQA exemption provisions.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda; participants joining via Zoom were permitted to raise their hand to speak with a 3-minute allocation per speaker.
actionItems: Scheduled to adopt resolution approving Historic Resources Commission Application No. 2026-11 and Historic Register Categorization No. 2026-6
Expected to recommend City Council authorization of Mills Act agreement for 1101 West Riviera Drive

discussions.item: CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT (CUP) NO. 2026-0011 FOR 1029 EAST FOURTH STREET

The project was determined to be exempt from further environmental review under CEQA Section 15301.

discussions.body: The Planning Commission was expected to consider applications to place the property at 2361 North Riverside Drive on the Santa Ana Register of Historical Properties as 'Contributive' and to execute a Historic Property Preservation Agreement (Mills Act agreement) with the property trustees. The Commission was scheduled to adopt a resolution approving the historic designation and recommend City Council authorize execution of the preservation agreement.

title: Planning Commission - Regular Meeting
overview: Based on the published agenda, the Santa Ana Planning Commission was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to consider a 20-unit townhome development project on West Fifth Street within the Harbor Mixed-Use Transit Corridor Specific Plan area. The meeting was set to address a Tentative Tract Map and Density Bonus Agreement application that would facilitate an attached townhome subdivision with one deed-restricted affordable unit.

agenda.item: Tentative Tract Map No. 2026-0010 and Density Bonus Agreement No. 2026-02 for properties located at 3317, 3319, 3321, 3327 and 3401 West Fifth Street

discussions.item: Tentative Tract Map No. 2026-0010 and Density Bonus Agreement No. 2026-02
discussions.body: The Planning Commission was scheduled to consider an application by Home Expo Commercial LLC for approval of a Tentative Tract Map and Density Bonus Agreement to facilitate construction of a 20-unit for-sale townhome development with one deed-restricted affordable unit for very low-income households on West Fifth Street within the Harbor Mixed-Use Transit Corridor Specific Plan area. The project was set to request five incentives/concessions and waivers or reductions from development standards related to common open space, private open space, and building setback under State Density Bonus Law. Environmental review was expected to rely on a 2014 Environmental Impact Report certified for the specific plan, with a Notice of Exemption filed under CEQA Guidelines Section 15195.

publicComment: Public comment was indicated on the agenda with provisions for in-person, Zoom, and written submissions, with a 3-minute speaking limit per commenter.
actionItems: Scheduled to adopt a resolution approving Tentative Tract Map No. 2026-0010 as conditioned
Scheduled to adopt a resolution approving density bonus concession and waivers or reductions in development standards as memorialized in Density Bonus Agreement No. 2026-02 as conditioned

overview: Based on the published agenda, the WDB Youth Council Committee was scheduled to hold a regular meeting to conduct routine business including electing officers for the 2026-2027 term and considering a recommendation to release a Request for Proposals for WIOA Youth Services procurement. The meeting was set to receive program reports from multiple youth service providers serving the Santa Ana community.

discussions.item: Election of Officers for the Santa Ana Youth Council for the 2026-2027 Term
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to elect a Chairperson and Vice Chairperson for the Santa Ana Youth Council to serve during the 2026-2027 term. This election was set to establish new leadership for the youth council's upcoming fiscal year.

discussions.item: Recommend the Release of a Request for Proposals for the Procurement of WIOA Youth Services for Program Year 2027–2028
discussions.body: The committee was set to consider recommending that the Workforce Development Board direct staff to develop, finalize, and release a Request for Proposal to procure Youth Service Providers for Program Year 2027-2028. This action was expected to facilitate the procurement process for youth workforce services in the upcoming program year.

discussions.item: Program Operator Reports
discussions.body: The committee was scheduled to receive reports from four youth service program operators: YSPN, Orange County Children's Therapeutic Arts Center, Working Wardrobes, and Hope Builders. These reports were expected to provide updates on program activities and outcomes from the various service providers.
